note: Paste into Offerings -> Import Offerings. Sources arrive disabled; toggle the ones you want. Compiled from https://transport.data.gouv.fr/api/datasets (the Point d'Acces National), 2026-09-08.

sources.name: Paris - Ile-de-France Mobilites
sources.notes: Every IDFM network: Metro, RER, Transilien, tram, bus. The PAN lists no GTFS-RT for IDFM -- realtime is behind PRIM (https://prim.iledefrance-mobilites.fr), which wants a per-account key. To add it, put the PRIM GTFS-RT URL in the trip updates field and an `apikey: <your key>` header on this source. The static zip is the largest in this bundle; expect a long first import.

sources.name: Marseille - Metropole Aix-Marseille-Provence
sources.notes: The `referentiel complet` feed: RTM plus every other network in the metropole (Aixenbus, Ciotabus, Cartreize, and the rest). Only service alerts are published as GTFS-RT; trip updates and vehicle positions are SIRI only.

sources.name: Lyon - TCL
sources.notes: SYTRAL Mobilites. Grand Lyon's own download (download.data.grandlyon.com) now answers 401 without an account, so this uses the mirrored `GTFS modifie` resource the PAN lists, which does not. No GTFS-RT: TCL publishes realtime as SIRI Lite only.

sources.name: Toulouse - Tisseo
sources.notes: One realtime feed carrying both trip updates and service alerts, so it goes in the shared field rather than being listed twice.

sources.name: Nice - Lignes d'Azur
sources.notes: Trip updates and vehicle positions from enRoute's ARA gateway. No service alerts feed.

sources.name: Nantes - Naolib
sources.notes: Realtime comes through the PAN proxy, which allows one request per 30 seconds per resource and answers 429 above that -- hence 60s trip updates and 600s alerts rather than the defaults.

sources.name: Montpellier - TaM
sources.notes: The urbain network, with all three realtime kinds. TaM publishes a second, suburbain network at the same paths with /Suburbain/ in place of /Urbain/; add it as its own source if you want it.

sources.name: Strasbourg - CTS
sources.notes: No GTFS-RT: the Eurometropole publishes realtime as SIRI Lite only.

sources.name: Bordeaux - TBM
sources.notes: All three realtime kinds. The apiKey in these URLs is Bordeaux Metropole's published open-data key, not a personal one.

sources.name: Lille - Ilevia
sources.notes: Trip updates only, through the PAN proxy -- so 60s rather than the default, for the same rate limit as Nantes.
